topic.readerProblem: Work out what Goodie AI actually costs: which published price is the annual rate versus month-to-month, what each plan includes, what drives the bill, and what a year really costs.
topic.connection: Helps AEOeye readers compare AI visibility monitoring platforms on real invoice terms before paying, and shows when a one-off audit is the better first step.

assessment: The page answers 'how much does Goodie AI cost' with the exact amounts published on higoodie.com on 2026-10-03, including the monthly versus annual prices read from the pricing page's own toggle data and confirmed in a browser. It adds the plan comparison matrix, the contract terms from Goodie's service agreement, and worked annual budgets with the arithmetic shown. It is documentation-based, says so near the top, corrects the earlier version's $3,990 annual figure, and does not claim hands-on use, output quality, or outcomes.

sources.supports: Core $399 / Pro $999 / Growth $275 displayed on the default annual toggle; monthly/quarterly values $478.80 / $1,198.80 / $330; toggle labels; plan comparison table (engines, prompts, countries, action credits, agent tokens, seats, export, API); 7-day trial on Core; Growth pitch workspaces and client-workspace add-on from $399; FAQ wording.
Fees non-refundable, taxes exclusive, auto-renewal, monthly cancellation at cycle end, 30 days' written notice for other terms, 30 days' notice of price changes, trials as agreed in writing.
August 4, 2026 copy: Explorer at $399/month with $479 behind the toggle, 3 core models, 100 prompts, 3 seats, 7-day trial.
April 9, 2026 copy: Explorer/Pro/Enterprise with demo buttons and no prices.
Goodie's Agent Readiness Audit is described as free with no signup or account.
Definition of MCP as an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external systems.
Definition of generative engine optimization (also called answer engine optimization).

Writer (Sonnet): classified every check mark and dash in the live comparison table programmatically before stating which plan includes Claude, Gemini, export, API, agentic commerce and the other features.

Writer (Sonnet): read Goodie's service agreement in raw page text and quoted only fee, renewal, cancellation, price-change and trial terms it states; compared Wayback snapshots from April 9, May 17 and August 4, 2026 to describe price history.

Writer (Sonnet): removed claims from the old answer page that the current pricing page no longer supports (Explorer name, 3,000-response and lookback figures, 30-day money-back guarantee, Pro as custom-quote-only) and dropped its third-party reviewer quote.

pricing.billing: Annual-billing monthly rate shown by default; monthly (brand) or quarterly (agency) billing costs 20% more; Pro and Enterprise start with a demo; Enterprise quote-only
pricing.verification: Read price attributes in the pricing page HTML and in a live browser toggle on 2026-10-03: Core $399 vs $478.80, Pro $999 vs $1,198.80, Growth $275 vs $330; recomputed that the annual rate equals 10/12 of the other rate ('2 months free') and derived yearly totals. The page prints no annual totals; taxes, upfront annual charging and card requirement for the trial are not stated.
